skipped.reason: Merged into the Thai download-pinterest-videos-iphone-android page. In Thai, 'ลงอัลบั้ม/แกลเลอรี่' and 'ลง iPhone/Android' are the same intent; two near-identical Thai pages would split ranking signals. The gallery keywords are secondaries there.

No Arabic demand for downloading a whole profile. 'تحميل صور حساب بنترست', 'تحميل ملف شخصي بنترست', 'تحميل جميع صور حساب بنترست', 'تحميل كل منشورات حساب بنترست' and 'تحميل جميع منشورات بنترست' return nothing in SA, EG and MA. 'تحميل حساب بنترست' means installing the app ('للكمبيوتر', 'اخر اصدار'), 'حساب بنترست' completes to account topics (مجاني، جاهز، للبيع، بدون ايميل), and 'تحميل بروفايل بنترست' completes to the profile picture. The only demand is the English 'pinterest profile downloader', which the English page serves. Cover it with one FAQ on /ar/pinterest-board-downloader that links to the English tool, and emit no ar hreflang for this page.

No Arabic demand. 'تحميل كاروسيل بنترست' and 'تحميل صور متعددة من بنترست' return nothing; 'كاروسيل بنترست' completes only to itself; 'carousel بنترست' completes in English toward creating carousel posts and ads. Carousels are folded into /ar/pinterest-pin-downloader ('منشور متعدد الصور', secondary keyword plus FAQ) and the image page FAQ.

The format is retired and the Arabic 'story' queries mean something else. Pinterest folded Idea Pins into ordinary Pins, and no current Arabic Pinterest term for them was found. 'قصص بنترست' completes to children's stories (قصص اطفال، قصص قصيرة)، 'ستوري بنترست' to Instagram-story ideas, and 'تحميل قصص بنترست' only to 'بالعربي'. The download phrasing that does exist ('تنزيل ستوري بنترست بدون علامه مائيه', 'تحميل فيديو ستوري بنترست بدون علامه مائيه') means a short vertical video to post as a story or status. That is video intent, so it is a secondary keyword plus an FAQ on /ar/pinterest-video-downloader. The English source page is also thin (one paragraph, no FAQ).

Thin demand, and the feature is not honest yet. Arabic demand is a handful of long tails ('تحميل صوت من بنترست', 'تحميل صوت بنترست بدون علامه مائيه', 'استخراج الصوت من فيديو بنترست اون لاين'); 'تحميل اغاني/موسيقى من بنترست', 'تحويل فيديو بنترست الى صوت/mp3' and 'تحميل الصوت من بنترست' return nothing, and 'بنترست mp3' completes only in English. More importantly, the 'MP3' the UI offers is the MP4 video URL saved under a .mp3 filename (src/components/DownloaderForm.tsx: entries.push({ url: vUrl, filename: `${safeTitle}_audio.mp3` }) and saveProxyDownload(videoUrl, mp3Name)). It is not transcoded, so iPhones and many players will not treat it as audio. An Arabic page promising 'استخراج الصوت MP3' would be a false claim. Revisit after real audio extraction ships, targeting 'تحميل صوت من بنترست'.

No Arabic demand for our intent, and the obvious Arabic word would mislead. 'تحميل فيديو من بنترست كروم' completes to car chrome trim ('كرومات', 'كرومات سوداء'); 'اضافة كروم بنترست' and 'اضافة بنترست جوجل كروم' complete to installing Pinterest's own Save-button extension on a computer; 'اضافة كروم لتحميل فيديو بنترست' and 'bookmarklet بنترست' return nothing. The only demand is the English 'pinterest video downloader chrome', which the English page serves. PintDownload is a bookmarklet, not a Chrome Web Store extension, so an Arabic 'إضافة' page would mislead. Mention the bookmarklet in the laptop guide instead.

The tool cannot serve Arabic users and the Arabic demand is for a different topic. /api/generate-seo has no language parameter, its Gemini prompt is English, and the fallback templates are English, so an Arabic page would hand Arabic users English titles. Arabic demand is weak: 'مولد عناوين بنترست' and 'عناوين بنترست' return nothing; 'عنوان بنترست' means the account's URL or email; 'سيو بنترست' completes in English. The real Arabic Pinterest-marketing demand is 'الربح من بنترست' (طريقة، شروط، دليل، هل يمكن، 2024) and 'التسويق بالعمولة بنترست'. That belongs on Arabic blog guides, not on this tool. Revisit if the generator gets an output-language parameter.

architecture.basis: architecture.md (sections 1–16) is adopted as the build spec. The items below are the merged decisions plus planner amendments (marked AMEND).
architecture.urls: English stays at the root. Locale prefix + native ASCII slugs, no trailing slash: /es, /es/descargar-videos-pinterest. th and ar keep the English slugs under their prefix (research: romanised Thai and Arabic-script slugs match nothing people type and encode badly when shared). de keeps the English slug for the Chrome page on purpose.
architecture.hreflang: Language-only codes (es pt fr de it nl id tr vi ru th ar) plus en; x-default = English URL of the same pageId. <html lang> may be more specific (pt-BR). One generator, alternatesFor(pageId), feeds HTML <link> tags and sitemap xhtml:link; a test asserts they are equal. Only live (pageId, locale) pairs appear; gated and unreleased pages are absent from every cluster.
architecture.routing: No Astro i18n config. src/i18n/routes.ts is the single source (PAGES, SLUGS, pathFor, routeForPath, alternatesFor, localeHome, localePagesOf). Three prerendered routes: src/pages/[locale]/index.astro, [locale]/[slug].astro, [locale]/404.astro (renamed to <loc>/404.html by an astro:build:done hook so Cloudflare serves it with status 404).
architecture.routeStatus: AMEND: SLUGS entries carry a status (live | gated-audio | gated-4k) and LOCALE_META carries live: boolean. getStaticPaths, alternates, sitemap, nav, footer and the language menu use only live pages of live locales. This lets Releases A/B/C and the Q1/Q2 gates ship from one codebase without branches. Content JSON for gated pages may exist; it is simply not routed.
architecture.contentModel: One JSON per (locale, pageId) in src/content/i18n/<loc>/<pageId>.json, validated by the zod schema in architecture.md §6.2 (title 40–62, description 120–158, H1 ≤ 60, no raw HTML, [[pageId|text]] internal links that fail the build when the target is not live in that locale, external links allowlisted to pinterest.com/help.pinterest.com). AMEND: schema adds .refine(s => s === s.normalize("NFC")) on every string (vi research: decomposed text breaks the length rule).
architecture.breadcrumb: AMEND: localized breadcrumbs and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD use content nav.label, not title.split("—"). Titles are therefore free to use ":" or "|" as the research wrote them; no locale needs to force an em dash. English pages keep today’s behaviour.
architecture.jsonLd: src/i18n/jsonld.ts: WebPage, SoftwareApplication (price 0, never aggregateRating), HowTo, FAQPage (only when visible), BreadcrumbList rooted at the locale home with LOCALE_META.homeLabel, Article with real datePublished/dateModified on guides; inLanguage = htmlLang on every entity; Organization @id shared with English; no WebSite/SearchAction on localized pages.
architecture.sitemap: One sitemap.xml with xmlns:xhtml; every live localized URL once with the full alternate set; lastmod from content dateModified (never build date). indexnow.mjs reads the same entries. robots.txt unchanged.
architecture.templates: HomePage.astro, ToolPage.astro, GuidePage.astro under src/components/i18n/. Shared components (TicketHero, HowToSteps, FaqSection, CompareTable, RelatedTools, BookmarkletGuide, FooterKeywordMatrix, AdSlot) gain optional ui/locale props whose defaults keep English HTML byte-identical apart from the head alternates and language menu. English .astro pages are not rewritten.
architecture.islands: Typed catalogs src/i18n/island/<loc>.ts imported only by server templates; each page passes pickIsland(locale, variant) as a prop (≈12–23 KB of JSON, 4–5 KB brotli; budget in §8). English defaults stay inline, so the English bundle does not grow and no locale string enters dist/_astro/*.js (post-build check). Plurals via Intl.PluralRules maps (ru one/few/many/other, ar zero…other). Route notices and StickyPasteBar resolve targets through a routes prop of the current locale. /api/extract gains an additive error code field only after mcp-server merges (parity fixtures updated in the same commit); until then localized pages show a localized generic error with the English server text as detail.
architecture.languageSelector: Server-rendered LanguageMenu.astro (<details>, real <a hreflang lang> links, endonyms, no flags). Links go to the current page’s live alternate, else that locale’s home (no hreflang attribute then). No redirect or banner by IP, Accept-Language or cookie. src/lib/i18n.ts, i18n-client.ts, LanguageSelector.tsx and DownloaderForm’s preferred_lang code are deleted (their strings overclaim 1080p and contain errors flagged by de/it/ar/id/nl research). English blog/legal pages: the menu links to locale homes.
architecture.rtl: Before any i18n work, one mechanical sweep converts physical Tailwind/CSS direction properties to logical ones, verified by zero pixel diff on 6 pages at 390/1440 light/dark. Then dir="rtl" on /ar, mirrored stub tear and stamp angle, rtl:-scale-x-100 on directional icons, swapped arrow-key handlers in carousels, <bdi>/dir="ltr" for URLs, code, pin.it, MP4, serial numbers; letter-spacing 0 for ar and th; Western digits (Intl.NumberFormat("ar",{numberingSystem:"latn"})). The URL input stays LTR; caret behaviour after paste is a QA item. Step illustrations with English text are replaced or captioned per locale.

phases.name: Content writers (12 in parallel)
inputs: i18n-plan.json matrix rows for the locale (title, description, H1, keywords are fixed; changing them is a slug/meta change request)
English page sources for facts only
the es pilot as the reference
phases.order: Write P1 pages first, then P2, then P3; gated pages last (content exists, route stays gated).
rules: Native copy, never sentence-by-sentence translation; at least 3 FAQ answers grounded in local intent traps from the research

Honesty: public only; no numbers about users/downloads/ratings; "largest size Pinterest publishes", never "original"; quality as "usually 720p, 1080p when the pin has it"; "no watermark" means we add none; credit-creators line; "Independent tool, not affiliated with Pinterest Inc."
Use the research’s Pinterest UI labels and flag unverified phone labels in review.nativeReviewer notes
Fix the lede warnings listed in validation.warnings
Run npm test and npm run build before handing off; slug/title changes go to viralnest-i18n-research/<loc>-slug-requests.md for infra

phases.name: QA (parallel)
steps: Automated: npm test, npm run build (postbuild health check), npm run test:seo-build, verify_i18n_build.py.

Native review ×12 by a different agent than the writer (fluency, register, search vocabulary, Pinterest UI labels against help.pinterest.com/<lang>, honesty, no English leftovers, no calques); human proofreaders where Q3 provides them.

Visual QA per script group (Latin; tr+vi; ru; th; ar RTL) with Playwright at 390×844 and 1440×900, light and dark: home, video, board, longest-H1 page, 404, DownloaderForm states with /api/extract mocked from tests/fixtures. Assert no horizontal scroll, H1 not clipped, script font loaded, stub label on one line, language menu keyboard-reachable, RTL mirroring correct.
SEO crawl against wrangler dev: architecture.md §13.5 table + full link crawl (no 4xx, no redirect chains, every localized page within 2 clicks of its locale home).

Perf: Lighthouse mobile on /, /es, /ru, /th, /ar and one deep page each; font bytes within budget; CLS 0; island props within the restated budget: each `messages` prop < 24 KB UTF-8 and < 5.5 KB brotli (tests/islands.entry.ts; the first "< 8 KB raw" could not hold the island strings — English alone is ≈12 KB).

phases.name: Close-out and release
steps: Skeptic agent challenges every QA finding; one fix batch; one confirm round.
Release A (es pt fr de it nl id tr vi) → Release B (ru th) → Release C (ar), each flipping LOCALE_META.live once its script-group QA is green.
Per release: submit sitemap in Search Console, Bing Webmaster (and Yandex Webmaster for ru); IndexNow the new URLs; URL Inspection on one page per locale.

Two weeks after each release: GSC performance filtered by prefix, plus the "Alternate page with proper canonical" and "Duplicate" buckets; merge or 301 any pair of pages Google treats as one (watch list below).

openQuestions.topic: Audio pages and the fake MP3
openQuestions.question: The "MP3" button saves the MP4 video under a .mp3 name. Should we make real audio extraction (lazy-loaded in-browser MP3 encoder for the video’s audio track; it also fixes the English audio page), or keep the 9 localized audio pages unpublished and only stop the fake .mp3 file?
openQuestions.recommendation: Build real MP3 extraction in Phase 0b. Every market searches "mp3"; the pages are already researched and validated. Until it ships, the pages stay gated.

openQuestions.topic: 4K explainer pages and the English 4K page
openQuestions.question: Six locales researched an honest "Is 4K possible? Here is the real quality" page (pt, fr, tr, vi, th, ar; titles now ask instead of promising). Their hreflang twin, the English 4K page, still promises "4K ultra quality" and "original uncompressed". Publish the six and rewrite the English 4K page to the same honest angle?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes to both. If the English 4K page must stay untouched (it may hold rankings), skip the six; es, de, it, nl, ru and id already fold 4K into a video-page FAQ.

openQuestions.question: Are human native speakers available to proofread any locale before it goes live? Otherwise launch on agent writer + separate agent reviewer only.
openQuestions.recommendation: Agent review is enough to launch es/pt/fr/de/it/nl/id; ask for humans first on ar, th and ru, where agent errors are hardest to spot and the research flagged the most unverified UI labels.

openQuestions.question: Once ads run on /de, German visitors expect an Impressum with a real name and postal address, plus a German privacy notice and ad consent. Do you want to publish these before ads go on /de (needs your details), or keep /de ad-free?
openQuestions.recommendation: Launch /de now (no ad network is wired up), and decide before monetising. Not legal advice.
